Updates:
Added the Combat Triangle. If you are at an advantage, you gain 25% damage. If you are at a disadvantage, you lose 25% damage.
If you are neutral (both your style and enemy's style match), there are no bonuses applied.
-Melee has an advantage over Ranged
-Ranged has an advantage over Magic
-Magic has an advantage over Melee

The same applies to enemies, they know Bloobs combat style.

Improved enemies to now attack at distant thresholds depending on their combat style.

Added Combat styles for every enemy in game in the Beastiary.

Added Combat styles for every enemy in game in the Enemy Tooltips.

Added messages when the player is in the wrong attack style or correct attack style to help teach the player about the combat triangle.

Combat info now has a Combat Triangle info tooltip, Hover over this will show you all your advantages and disadvantages.

Because off this change I've added 10 additional inventory slots to allow having extra gear in your inventory.

Experience per hour for Tracking and thieving will now reset when starting a new action.

Buffed Tracking Magic/Leather Material drop quantities.

Added New Tracking Prestige Buffs at Prestige level 1.

Crafts Per Hour now resets when crafting a new item, for Crafting, BowCrafting, Smithing.

Added a Message to Imbuing to notify the player when a item is doubled from a potion.

notes.title: Version 1.6.7.1 - Soulbinding Changes, Combat Prestige Reward Stage 2
notes.content:
Version 1.6.7.1 - Soulbinding Changes, Combat Prestige Reward Stage 2



Updates:
We are very happy with the release of the Soulbinding skill overall. The skill is one of the most unique features we have added so far and we are very proud of it. We have received a great amount of feedback, and have been gathering the data we required to make needed changes. The feedback we have received has been overwhelmingly positive, but there are some points that need addressed. Although Bloob's Adventure Idle is an idle game, we always aim to respect and value our players' time, and will always make changes to do this better. 

Soulbinding Changes.
Soul drop rates:

Current --> New (Base/Golden/Corrupted)
Skill Souls 1 in 750k / 2.5m / 10m --> 250k / 750k / 2.5m
Enemies 1 in 25k / 75k / 200k --> 7.5k / 25k / 75k
Bosses 1 in 10k / 30k / 75k --> 5k / 15k / 50k
Tracking  Unchanged

New Soulbinding Prestige Rewards:

In addition to all of the Soulbdinding Prestige rewards currently awarded there will be a new addition. Each Prestige Level in Soulbinding will now award +25 Soulbinding XP Cap per Active Soul. 

HitPoints Prestige now gains the ability to negate all damage, 1 Percent chance per Prestige Level.
Defence Prestige now gains the ability to reflect damage, Starting at 25% chance with an additional 4% per prestige level, Reflect damage percentage starts at 10% increasing by 1% per prestige level.
Updated Attack, Range, Magic accuracy that goes over 100% now gets converted into a double hit chance, the damage colour is displayed in grey to show the player you've proc'd , This is built for future weapons.
Improved the bank ui by adding space on the y position off each bank slot, improved the scroll speed for easier navigation.
Added Information for Potions , this will now display the vessel it belongs to Vial, Flask, Bottle, Decanter.

Bug Fixes:
Herbology Skill information should now correctly open and close when quickly using the cauldron after finishing crafting.
Fixed an issue with enemys not attacking bloob correctly.
Fixed an issue with Souldex not updating Souls discovered.
Fixed Spells not showing their damage.

notes.title: Version 1.6.6.7 - Beastmastery QoL
notes.content:
Version 1.6.6.7 - Beastmastery QoL

Updates:
Auto-BM: This will no longer require Beastmastery Prestige 1, and instead will be purchasable from the BM shop for 250 points. In addition to this, Auto-BM will be able to be turned on/off at Darko Beastmaster once the unlock is purchased. 

BM Prestige: Every BM prestige will now award/add a 2.0% chance to ignore an enemies Damage-Reduction on a successful hit during combat. This will cap out at 20% with P10 Beastmastery.

We understand that getting to P1 BM without being able to utilize Auto-BM to get there has been a significant grind for players and have received a great deal of feedback from players regarding this. This important feedback prompted us to take a closer look and make much needed adjustments. 

Note for anyone with Auto-BM unlocked already You will need to spend the 250 BM points to unlock Auto-BM. Fortunately, these points can be obtained fairly quickly at this level. 

To go along with these changes there will also be a brand new free! hat added to the Bloobimization shop to symbolize Bloob's Adventure Idle's Early-Access status.

notes.title: Version 1.6.6 - SoulBinding Release
notes.content:
Version 1.6.6 - SoulBinding Release

New Skill
SoulBinding
You can now find souls from any activity that gains experience. Whether killing or skilling, souls can be found almost anywhere. There are currently 135 Souls with a total of 355 variants. 330 can be found through gameplay and 25 can be purchased from the shop right away.

Drops are fairly rare; do not expect to finish this quickly. All souls, besides ones purchased from the shop, will offer additional stat bonuses.

New Auto Bank/Auto Sell Systems
These are tied directly to the SoulBinding. Open your Codex and check out the Souldex tab to get started. These new systems are limited at the beginning of the skill, but leveling up SoulBinding will unlock more slots and improve how many items your souls handle at once. Eventually, you will be able to sell items for more than their base value using this new system.

Banked Time – Bloob will store up to 24 hours of offline time.

It’s hard to believe, but Bloobs Adventure Idle Steam is officially one year in the making! When I started this journey, I had no previous experience with game development. The Beginning: A year ago, I was just getting my feet wet in the world of game development. There were countless hours spent figuring out the basics, building prototypes, and learning what worked (and what definitely didn’t!). But with each mistake, I learned valuable lessons that shaped Bloobs Adventure into what it is today.

What’s Been Accomplished: In this past year, I’ve implemented so many exciting systems that have made Bloobs Adventure more than just an idle game. Here are some of the highlights:

Challenges & Learning: This year hasn’t been without its challenges. From building 22 unique skills to creating my own inventory, bank, equipment, and customization systems, every step has been a learning experience. Implementing features like MiniMap click-to-move, Facepunch Steamworks integration, and Steam Achievements has definitely kept me on my toes. Debugging issues like the minimap click functionality has been a rollercoaster ride, but each challenge has pushed me to grow as a developer. I’m grateful for everything I’ve learned along the way.

Looking Forward: What’s next for Bloobs Adventure? I’ve got big plans! You can expect more content, Content to 100 and beyond, and even more customization options to make your Bloobs experience truly your own.

Thank you to everyone who’s supported me this past year—whether you’ve watched a devlog, played the game, or shared your feedback. This journey wouldn’t be possible without you, and I can’t wait to see where the next year takes us!

Player Backup System Overview
Our game features a robust backup system designed to safeguard your progress. Here's how it works:

Automatic Backups: Each time you save your backup or a automated backup, a backup of your current save file is automatically created. This ensures that you always have access to recent versions of your game progress.

Multiple Backups: The system maintains up to 5 backup files. These backups are labeled sequentially (e.g., SaveFile-1.es3, SaveFile-2.es3, etc.), allowing you to access previous versions of your save.

Cycle System: Once the maximum of 5 backups is reached, the oldest backup is automatically overwritten by the newest one. This ensures that you always have the latest saves without needing to manage them manually.

Timestamp Integrity: Each backup file is timestamped with the exact time it was created, so you can easily identify when each backup was made.

This backup system is designed to provide you with peace of mind, ensuring that your progress is always secure and recoverable, even in the event of an unexpected issue.
